title: Verducatib — Earlier NDA Submission (China) Probability Analysis & Stakeholder Communication (2026 Apr PEC)

background.text: Current best-case NDA submission is Dec 2027 with approval Dec 2028. Competitive driver: local DPP-1 inhibitor HSK31858 expected NDA approval before Q1 2028, ~1 year earlier than verducatib, materially affecting pricing leverage and NRDL positioning.
background.quote: The local DPP‑1 inhibitor HSK31858 is expected to get NDA approval before Q1 2028 (~1 year earlier than verducatib under the current plan), which could materially affect pricing leverage and market positioning if verducatib enters NRDL 1y later.

background.text: Accelerated NDA submission target is Oct 29, 2027 (2 months earlier than best case Dec 2027), shared goal for US/EU/China. Accelerated NDA approval target is June 2028 to trigger 2028 NRDL negotiation.
background.quote:
NDA submission in Oct 2027 is a shared goal for US/EU, and China.
The evaluation was well aligned with global clinical development team (evidence team).

background.text: Critical assumptions for Oct 29, 2027 submission: LPO Jul 1, DBL Jul 26, TLR Aug 5; CMC DS PPQ completion Sep 25 without unexpected analytical results; PR confirmed Oct 2027 via pre-NDA based on ~40 adolescents (75 planned); whole dossier ready Oct 15; eCTD publication in one week vs standard 10WD.
background.quote:
LPO on 01Jul2027, DBL on 26Jul2027, TLR on 05Aug2027
CMC DS PPQ completion on 25Sep2027 without unexpected analytical results
PR confirmed in Oct 2027 via pre-NDA (30WD for pediatric case)，based on data from ~40 adolescents (75 planned for the trial).
Whole dossier ready on 15 Oct 2027 in CN and EN
eCTD publication in one week (vs standard 10WD)

background.text: Critical assumption for June 2028 approval: NDA review under PR completed within 8 months (vs current benchmark 12M for NDA approval with PR), including QC testing, ad hoc panel meeting, potential GMP inspection, fast negotiation for approval documents.
background.quote:
Approval in 8M (vs current benchmark for NDA approval with PR is 12M) including
QC testing
ad hoc panel meeting
potential GMP inspection (if CN progress faster than US)
Fast negotiation for approval documents
